title: boltonia asteroides var. latisquama
intro: Boltonia asteroides var. latisquama, commonly known as False Aster or White Doll's Daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and stomach cramps. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, making it a potential remedy for conditions like irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The bioactive constituents of Boltonia asteroides var. latisquama include volatile oils and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
